title: ze_best_guess
description:
ZE_BEST_GUESS 
 
 ZE_BEST_GUESS is a simple straightforward Zombie Escape map with a quiz twist .

Fight your way through 6 quiz stages where humans must pick A / B or C .

Pick right and receive no damage penalty . Pick wrong and receive a -20 hp penalty . Keep moving, keep thinking, and don’t let the zombies catch up while everyone argues over the “obvious” answer.

Along the way, humans must clear two minigame events to progress:

 Play Your Cards Right 

Guess if the next card is Higher or Lower than the last.

 Correct : +12 HP

 Wrong : -15 HP

 No guess : -20 HP

 Target Range 

At the Target Range section, when the shutter opens, you have 8 seconds to hit 6 randomly selected targets.

Fail, and you’ll be waiting for the next shutter cycle while zombies close the distance.

 Final Showdown: Humans vs Zombies 

After Question 6, the map ends with a 7-question team showdown .

Every player's correct answer earns 1 point for your team. After 7 questions, the team with the most points wins.

The losing team gets sent to the tram to their deaths, rolling past the Awards Wall showing stats from the run: MVPs, fastest, smartest, and the dumbest.

The winners then trigger the crusher to finish the job.

Think fast. Aim faster. And if you don’t know the answer…… guess .
